title: Turn your folder into the map
subtitle: Before the OS folder picker opens, just {count} things to know.
bulletAnyFolder: Any markdown folder works: no special format required.
bulletLocal: Atlas opens this folder locally and does not upload it to an Atlas backend. A coding agent you later connect may send prompts and context to its own provider.
bulletStarter: Pick an empty folder and we scaffold starter docs for you.
bulletPermission: After you pick, the browser asks to Allow. That grants this page local file access; it is separate from any AI-provider connection.
actionCreateNew: Start fresh with an empty folder
